thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING eng-runtime — p99 decode latency spike (us-west-2) for model-ggml-13b. p99 ~ 1.8s (baseline 0.4s). Streaming stalls observed. Auto-escalation to oncall.

ana (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Anyone rolling kernels or compiler changes in the last 3h?

mike (runtime): I saw a canary kernel rollout ~2h ago that included new TRT/FlashAttention kernels + a compiler flag tweak (strip_fast_math=true). Looking.

priya (sre): seeing correlated paging + decode queue growth on us-west-2-gpupool-3. p95 also up (~650ms). Streaming stalls reported by the streaming proxy — tail stall rate ~0.9% -> 3.6% traffic.

lucas (infra): checked deploy-bot logs: 
```
deploy-bot: rollout kernelset/2026-03-14-rt_optim v2 -> 100% at 1799007000
changes: TRT flash-attn v0.9.1, compiler: -O3 -march=native -fnew-kernel-path
```

ana (oncall): ok timeline matches. Is there a quick mitigation (disable new kernel, route to fallback)? Need to reduce p99 ASAP.

mike (runtime): We can force route model-ggml-13b to kernelset/legacy-rt (fallback) with a routing policy toggle. Doing a gradual 50% -> 100% fallback. Applying now.

sam (platform): please run the route toggle in console. I don't have perms to change kernel routing.

mike (runtime): running CLI: 
```
redwoodctl route set --model model-ggml-13b --kernel kernelset/legacy-rt --weight 50
```

status-bot: Incident status updated: mitigation in progress — routing 50% -> legacy kernel.

priya (sre): after 2 minutes: p99 dropped to ~900ms, tail stalls down to 1.5%. p95 ~450ms. Good improvement.

lucas (infra): I'll start a quick rollback of kernelset/2026-03-14-rt_optim from the rollouts page to prevent further canary -> stable propagation while we triage.

mike (runtime): digging into profiler traces. Early signs: decode kernel busy-waits and higher page-fault / mmap churn in shared KV cache path. Suspect the FlashAttn kernels interact badly with our mmap/KV reclamation under certain sequence lengths.

ana (oncall): any customer-facing impact? Should we update status page?

priya (sre): CS tickets: two customers (acme-analytics, quickchat) reported streaming stall timeouts in last 20m. Error rate bump from 0.1% -> 1.2% for those orgs. Recommend status page: "Degraded performance for some models in us-west-2; mitigation underway."

status-bot: Posted to status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2891 — Verified by priya.

mike (runtime): collected a snippet from worker logs showing repeated kernel compile-path warnings and page-fault spikes: 
```
[worker-12] WARN decode: kernel_select: fallback candidate compiled with flashattn=on, mmap-churn=high
[worker-12] ERROR decode: vm_faults=1329, kv_cache_evictions=87, decode_latency=1745ms
```

sam (platform): Could this be triggered by certain request size/streaming patterns? Any correlation with sequence length?

mike (runtime): yes — sample distribution shows a bump in >2048 token prefills around the time of the rollout. FlashAttn optimized kernels assume contiguous attention buffers; our reclaim path can cause fragmentation which triggers excessive page faults under the new code path.

ana (oncall): plan? Short-term: keep routing fallback until we stabilize. Mid-term: toggle compile flag to disable problematic optimization and redeploy kernelset to canary. Long-term: patch mmap/kvcache to avoid fragmentation.

lucas (infra): rollback is in progress, but we need to coordinate with builds. I'll block the rollout pipeline and pin kernelset/legacy-rt for affected models.

mike (runtime): I'll prepare a hotfix PR to remove the new compile flag `-fnew-kernel-path` and build a patched kernelset/rt_optim_hotfix. If CI is green, we can canary to a small subset.

priya (sre): for post-incident metrics: export p95/p99 and streaming stall rate for last 6h and annotate the timeline with rollout and mitigation timestamps. I'll own the SLO breach calc and external communications.

sam (platform): note: disabling the optimized kernel will increase CPU/GPU cost slightly per token; we should include that in the customer update if they ask.

ana (oncall): handoff: I'm going to stabilize the routing 100% legacy for the next 30m, then hand to next oncall @maria at 1799013000. Add owners: mike (runtime) for hotfix, priya (sre) for impact comms, lucas (infra) for rollout block.

mike (runtime): hotfix PR opened: https://git.redwood/rt/kernels/pulls/412 — removing `-fnew-kernel-path`, reverting flash-attn bump for the canary build. CI queued.

status-bot: mitigation success metric: after 10m of 100% fallback, p99 baseline ~420ms, tail stalls ~0.4%, customer error rates returning to baseline.

priya (sre): SLO impact: preliminary calc shows a 12-minute SLO breach window for p99 for model-ggml-13b across us-west-2 with estimated 0.4% of total requests experiencing streaming stall timeouts. Will finalize in postmortem.

lucas (infra): rollout pipeline is now blocked. Old kernelset pinned. I'll also schedule a kernel smoke test for seq len 4k patterns to replicate.

mike (runtime): CI green on hotfix build. Plan: canary 5% with rt_optim_hotfix for 15m, monitor p99 and vm_faults. Will not enable flash-attn in that canary.

ana (oncall): starting canary 5% now.

status-bot: canary started at 1799012400 -> 5% traffic to rt_optim_hotfix. Monitoring p95/p99 and vm_faults.

priya (sre): canary metrics after 8m: no p99 increase, vm_faults unchanged. Suggest progressive increase to 25% in 10m if stable.

mike (runtime): bumping to 25%.

ana (oncall): 25% steady. p99 stable. Good. I'll keep the thread open for handoff. Maria (next oncall) will take over the remainder of the remediation window.

status-bot: incident severity downgraded to "degraded performance" — mitigation in place.

ana (oncall): Handoff now to @maria (oncall) at 1799013000. Next steps: finalize postmortem owner, schedule kernel patch review, update docs for kernel rollout checklist (include mmap stress tests).

mike (runtime): assigning postmortem to myself + lucas; target draft in 48h.

priya (sre): I'll file customer follow-ups for acme-analytics and quickchat with incident timeline and mitigations performed.

status-bot: thread closed for active changes; will reopen if metrics regress.

maria (oncall): ack handoff (via DM) — I'll pick up monitoring and follow the postmortem tracker in the morning.
